append.detail: PART 1 2026-10-26: the nav list and the mobile bar's centre button now use spacing tokens (h-4.25, h-5.5, h-6, h-6.5, translate-y-4.5), 20 sites. They scale with the density root (17px), so icons render about 6% larger than the old fixed sizes. Still open: the three tab-bar icons (h-[22px] w-[22px] shrink-0) because components/layout/header-fit.test.ts pins that exact string and a pin rewrite needs Daniel's exact words.
